name: Grace Akello
headline: Runs free smartphone classes for market vendors
bio: Every Saturday Grace teaches vendors at Lira Main Market how to use WhatsApp Business, mobile money safely and Google Maps listings. More than 300 vendors have joined her classes since January.

name: Denis Okello
headline: Teaches boda boda riders to spot mobile money scams
bio: Denis turned a stage meeting into a weekly safety talk. Riders now share scam alerts in a WhatsApp group of over 900 members.

name: Patience Nabirye
headline: Helps farmer groups use government e-services
bio: Patience walks farmer groups through online registration, e-receipts and NIRA services, one phone at a time.

name: Moses Ocen
headline: Started a weekend computer club for school leavers
bio: Moses borrowed two laptops and started a Saturday club. It now has 45 members learning typing, spreadsheets and job applications.

name: Brian Ojok
headline: Built an SMS crop price alert for farmers
bio: Farmers text a crop name and get the latest prices from three markets. Over 1,200 farmers use it each week.

name: Faith Atim
headline: Writes AI study notes in Acholi
bio: Faith uses AI tools to draft revision notes in Acholi, then checks every page with teachers before sharing them.

name: Ivan Mugisha
headline: Runs a solar charging and Wi-Fi kiosk
bio: Ivan's kiosk charges phones and sells short Wi-Fi bundles near a trading centre with no power line.

name: Sharon Achan
headline: Builds simple online shops for tailors
bio: Sharon has set up online catalogues for 40 tailors, who now take orders on WhatsApp with photos and prices.

name: Joan Adongo
headline: Uses AI to plan lessons and teaches pupils to check it
bio: Joan shows her S3 class how AI gets things wrong, and how to check every answer against a textbook.

name: Peter Ebong
headline: Runs a phone based maths club
bio: Peter's learners solve maths problems shared in a class group and explain their answers in voice notes.

name: Ruth Namutebi
headline: Trained 60 teachers on digital marking
bio: Ruth showed teachers at three schools how to use free tools to mark, track and share results.

name: Emmanuel Odongo
headline: Brought a computer lab back to life
bio: Emmanuel repaired eight old computers with his students and now runs typing and spreadsheet lessons.

name: Agnes Auma
headline: Mentors girls in coding
bio: Agnes runs a monthly coding meet for girls aged 14 to 20, with 70 regular members.

name: Doreen Kyomuhendo
headline: Leads a women's online selling group
bio: Doreen trains women in tourism crafts to sell online, from product photos to delivery.

name: Lillian Apio
headline: First woman ICT officer in her district
bio: Lillian set up online records for the district health office and trains new staff.

name: Winnie Nakato
headline: Runs free cyber safety talks in schools
bio: Winnie has spoken to over 5,000 students about online safety, privacy and reporting abuse.

name: Ober Fresh Juices
headline: Takes orders on WhatsApp and delivers by boda
bio: A two person juice business that tripled sales after moving orders and payments to WhatsApp and mobile money.

name: Kwania Agro Supplies
headline: Sends farmers planting reminders by SMS
bio: The shop texts customers when to plant, spray and harvest, and stock runs out less often.

name: Mama Ruth Salon
headline: Books appointments online
bio: The salon moved bookings to a free online calendar, cutting waiting times and no shows.

name: Pakwach Fish Traders
headline: Uses a shared spreadsheet for daily prices
bio: Twelve traders share prices in one spreadsheet, so buyers in Arua and Gulu know what to expect.

name: Adyel Youth ICT Corner
headline: Free computer time for young people
bio: Open six days a week with ten computers and a printer for CVs and applications.

name: Layibi Community Library
headline: Library with Wi-Fi and phone charging
bio: Offers free Wi-Fi hours and weekend digital skills classes.

name: Oli Digital Space
headline: Training room for refugee and host youth
bio: Runs online work classes for young people from the settlement and the town.

name: Namakwekwe Innovation Room
headline: Maker space for students
bio: Students build and repair electronics and learn basic coding.

name: Nyendo Learning Hub
headline: Evening classes for working adults
bio: Evening computer classes for traders and workers.

headline: From no phone skills to running a shop page
bio: From no phone skills to running a shop page.
